raw:
Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 1
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly assumed Gero II’s father was “likely Gero I” and even directed searches toward Gero I’s death date, conflating lineages. This initial misidentification set the research on the wrong track and led to ongoing confusion about the correct person and death date (the father was Thietmar, Margrave of Meissen).
